Map the arguments of established network packages to psychnets

Source: R/crosswalk.R
net_crosswalk.Rd

net_crosswalk() maps the arguments of qgraph, IsingFit, mgm and psychonetrics functions to their psychnets counterparts, as a table with one row per argument. It shows which function fits the same model, which argument corresponds to which, and where the defaults or the meaning of an argument differ, for analyses moved to this package from those packages.

The table covers qgraph::EBICglasso() (ebic_glasso()), qgraph::cor_auto() (cor_auto()), qgraph::ggmModSelect() (ggm_modselect()), IsingFit::IsingFit() (ising_fit()), mgm::mgm() (mgm_fit()) and psychonetrics::panelgvar() (panel_gvar()); reference selects one of them. Each row records whether the argument is identical, renamed, has a different default or a different meaning, or exists in only one of the two functions, with a short note.

The result is a data frame with one row per argument; nothing is fitted.

Intensive time-series models (graphicalVAR, mlVAR) are not covered by this package.

Usage

net_crosswalk(
  reference = c("all", "EBICglasso", "cor_auto", "ggmModSelect", "IsingFit", "mgm",
    "panelgvar")
)

Arguments

reference

The reference function to show: "all" (default), "EBICglasso", "cor_auto", "ggmModSelect", "IsingFit", "mgm" or "panelgvar".

Value

A data frame with one row per argument and columns reference (the reference function, as pkg::fn), psychnet (the corresponding function in this package), ref_arg and psychnet_arg (the argument names, "-" when there is no counterpart), status ("identical", "renamed", "default differs", "semantics differ", "reference only" or "psychnet only") and note.

Conditions

psychnet_bad_input when reference is not one of the listed values.

See also

psychnet(), which also accepts the qgraph and bootnet method names.

Examples

net_crosswalk("EBICglasso")
#>             reference    psychnet           ref_arg      psychnet_arg
#> 1  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso                 S        cor_matrix
#> 2  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso                 n                 n
#> 3  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso             gamma             gamma
#> 4  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso           nlambda           nlambda
#> 5  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso  lambda.min.ratio  lambda_min_ratio
#> 6  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso         threshold         threshold
#> 7  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso penalize.diagonal penalize_diagonal
#> 8  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso             refit             refit
#> 9  qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso           checkPD                 -
#> 10 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso    penalizeMatrix                 -
#> 11 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso     countDiagonal                 -
#> 12 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso  returnAllResults                 -
#> 13 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso           verbose                 -
#> 14 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso                 -              data
#> 15 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso                 -        cor_method
#> 16 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso                 -         na_method
#> 17 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso                 -            native
#> 18 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso                 -            labels
#> 19 qgraph::EBICglasso ebic_glasso                 -       lambda_path
#>              status
#> 1           renamed
#> 2         identical
#> 3         identical
#> 4         identical
#> 5           renamed
#> 6  semantics differ
#> 7           renamed
#> 8  semantics differ

#> 4                                                                                                                                                                              default 100

#> 10                                                                                                                                       per-edge penalty matrix; psychnet uses scalar rho
